title: 🚗 Audi SUV price

messages.content: Question: How much is an SUV from Audi?
The prices for Audi SUVs vary depending on the specific model and trim. Based on the search results I observed, the prices range from $31,647 to $125,800.

webSearch.prompt: Question: How much is an SUV from Audi?

At the end of the loop either Answer or restate your Thought and Action.

Use Action to run one of these actions available to you:
- calculate[python math expression]
- research[lookup on the internet]
Observation will be the result of running those actions
